**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Advertise the newly supported tag operators**

When an assistant/MCP client follows `GetRuleOptions`' instruction to call it before previewing or creating a rule, `Assistant::Function::GetRuleOptions#filter_operators` (`app/models/assistant/function/get_rule_options.rb:57-60`) still removes `!=` and `is_not_null`, so these new branches remain undiscoverable on that rule surface. This change also makes `test/models/assistant/function/preview_rule_test.rb:88-92` fail because it still asserts that `!=` is rejected, whereas `validate_rule` now successfully applies it; remove the special-case filter and update the assistant contract tests along with the new support.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L17-L18](https://github.com/we-promise/sure/blob/5b579f9a42c4db35c4cc45b7a024cd4b0cfa5d8f/AGENTS.md#L17-L18)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->

Good catch, thanks. Fixed in 0affb686: `GetRuleOptions` now lists all four tag operators, and `preview_rule_test` checks that `!=` and `is_not_null` validate, while an operator the filter doesn't list (`>`) is still rejected. `test/models/assistant`, `test/models/rule*` and the rules controller tests: 659 runs, 0 failures.

Reviewed the diff, the existing Codex finding/fix, and the follow-up commit. A few notes beyond what's already been flagged:

**Logic looks correct.** `!=` as `NOT EXISTS(taggings WHERE tag_id = value)` correctly includes untagged transactions (not just "has a different tag"), which matches the semantics documented for other select-type filters in `app/models/rule/condition_filter.rb` (`!=` uses `IS DISTINCT FROM` so NULL/"not set" counts as not-equal). `is_not_null` as a bare `EXISTS` for "has any tag" is the natural complement to the existing `is_null` branch. The updated doc comment on `tagging_exists` (`app/models/rule/condition_filter/transaction_tag.rb:33-35`) accurately reflects the new negation behavior.

**The Codex-flagged gap (`GetRuleOptions` still hiding the new operators, and a stale preview test) is resolved** in commit `0affb686` — `filter_operators`/the special-case tag filtering was removed and `get_rule_options.rb` now just delegates to `filter.operators`, with `get_rule_options_test.rb` and `preview_rule_test.rb` updated accordingly (added "accepts every operator the tag filter lists" using `!=`/`is_not_null`, and the rejection test switched to `>`, which is correctly still unsupported for `select`). Good catch-and-fix cycle.

**No UI/locale changes needed here, and that's correct**: `not_equal_to`/`is_not_empty` are pre-existing keys in the shared `select`/`text` `OPERATORS_MAP` (already used by category/merchant filters), not new strings this PR introduces, and the operator list is rendered generically from `filter.operators` — so no `DS::*`/`t()` work was skipped.

**One pre-existing, out-of-scope observation**: `rules.condition_filters.operators.not_equal_to` / `is_empty` / `is_not_empty` / `contains` / `does_not_contain` are missing from several locale files (`de`, `es`, `hu`, `it`, `nb`, `nl`, `pt-PT`, `ro`, `vi`, `zh-CN`, `zh-TW` only define `equal_to`), while `ca`, `fr`, `pl`, `ru`, `tr`, `uk` have them. Not introduced by this PR — the keys already existed and were already missing for the merchant/category/text filters that use the same operators — but worth a separate follow-up issue since this change does make those operators reachable for tags too in locales that will now silently fall back to English.

Test coverage (model-level `Rule::Condition` tests plus the assistant function tests) looks adequate for the stated scope.

Thanks! Agreed on the missing operator keys in those 11 locales. I'll leave them out of this PR, since they also affect the category/merchant/text filters. Happy to open a follow-up issue listing the missing keys per locale.
